create_Host_runtime: create a Host runtime instance with a run command and optional build commands
run_Launcher_process: run a Launcher subprocess asynchronously with PTY pipes and environment variables
build_Host_commands: build a project by executing Host build commands via subprocess in bash
handle_Launcher_shutdown: handle graceful shutdown of a Launcher process with SIGTERM and SIGKILL fallback
get_Launcher_pid: get the process ID of a running Launcher subprocess
